answer: 4f Series: Ce (58) to Lu (71) | 5f Series: Th (90) to Lr (103)

versions: Explain the variation in size of Lanthanoids and Actinoids.
answer:
● Lanthanoids: Size gradually decreases from La → Lu due to Lanthanoid Contraction EXCEPT Eu -> largest size (no confirmed reason)
● Actinoids: Size gradually decreases from Ac → Lr due to Actinoid Contraction.

versions: Explain the variation in size of tripositive ions of Lanthanoids and Actinoids.
answer:
● Ln³⁺: Ionic size regularly decreases from La³⁺ → Lu³⁺ due to Lanthanoid Contraction.
● An³⁺: Ionic size regularly decreases from Ac³⁺ → Lr³⁺ due to Actinoid Contraction.

What are the properties of Lanthanoids?
answer: Silvery-white, soft metals, tarnish rapidly, generally show +3 oxidation state, form coloured and paramagnetic ions.

versions: What are the uses of Lanthanoids?
answer:
● Mischmetal contains ~95% lanthanoids + ~5% Fe; used in lighter flints and Mg-based alloys.
● Petroleum Cracking
● Flourescent in TVs.

versions: Write the general reactions of Lanthanoids with O₂, acids, halogens, H₂O, C, N₂ and S.
answer:
● O₂: Ln + O₂ → Ln₂O₃
● Acid: Ln + H⁺ → Ln³⁺ + H₂
● Halogens: Ln + X₂ → LnX₃
● H₂O: Ln + H₂O → Ln(OH)₃ + H₂
● C: Ln + C → LnC₂
● N₂: Ln + N₂ → LnN
● S: Ln + S → Ln₂S₃
